purpose: Four strongest baseline-vs-modified comparisons on one 0-1 axis
caveat: Heterogeneous metric types on a shared axis; bar heights are NOT interchangeable across categories. Natural evidence coverage is not accuracy.

purpose: GOLD-01 accuracy and macro F1, baseline (bare) vs modified (labeled)
caveat: Curated controlled benchmark; hypotheses are mechanically constructed, not free-running generated claims.

purpose: GOLD-01 per-class precision / recall / F1 for both systems
caveat: Precision/recall are legitimate here ONLY because GOLD-01 carries real per-item labels; no natural-data figure in this package uses them.

purpose: GOLD-01 3x3 confusion matrices, baseline vs modified
caveat: Counts are per-item verifier decisions against GOLD labels.

purpose: GOLD-02 synthetic stress-set contradiction recall and outcome split
caveat: Every record is CONTRADICTED by construction, so recall here is a detection-sensitivity measure on deliberately corrupted claims — it is not a natural-data accuracy figure.

purpose: Paired 209-claim evidence coverage, baseline v0 pool vs modified v0+v1 pool
caveat: Coverage = retrieval found a usable record. NOT a correctness or accuracy measure.

purpose: McNemar discordant-pair counts behind the 209-claim coverage result
caveat: Paired binary event: claim received usable evidence.

purpose: Corpus-level evidence coverage over all 588 pooled natural claims, v0 vs v0+v1
caveat: Corpus-level, not a paired-arm experiment; complements the paired 209 result.

purpose: Verifier verdict distributions on natural claims
caveat: Verdict counts are the NLI model's own outputs, NOT correctness labels.

purpose: Premise-framing effect on natural-data verdicts (batch1 n=251, batch2 n=236)
caveat: Same claims and same v0 evidence pool in each pair; only premise framing differs. Verdict shifts are decisiveness, not measured correctness.

purpose: Premise-framing verdict shift on the same 147 evidence-matched natural claims
caveat: ENTAILED 0 -> 13 is a count of model verdicts reached, NOT of claims proven correct.

purpose: Verifier confidence per verdict on the 588-claim natural aggregate
caveat: Confidence is the NLI model's own softmax certainty, not correctness.

purpose: Deterministic threshold sweep (0.50-0.95) on GOLD-01 for both premise framings
caveat: A sensitivity description, not a threshold search; production threshold was not changed on the strength of this sweep.

purpose: Correction funnel stage counts, five populations kept strictly separate
caveat: Synthetic and natural populations must never be pooled into one rate. The natural cumulative denominator is a project-history rollup, not one experiment.

purpose: Shipped / re-verification-failed / scope-rejected split per population
caveat: 0/5 -> 1/10 is a directional, isolated-by-design shift, not a statistically supported rate.

purpose: Observed counts for each programmatic safety mechanism
caveat: 0 observed unsafe shipments is an observation on a finite tested history, not a proof that unsafe shipments are impossible.

purpose: All eight ablation factors with evidence grade, isolation status and statistics
caveat: Grade communicates evidence strength (isolation + n + statistical support), not effect size. Grade E = the experiment does not exist.

purpose: Deterministic scope-gate replay over 11 real historical scope violations
caveat: The replay stops at the scope gate. Whether the one unblocked case would actually ship an ENTAILED correction is NOT answered by this artifact.

purpose: Wall-clock runtime and peak VRAM per experiment arm, GPU and CPU rows separated
caveat: Wall-clock time is a hardware/thermal/load measure, not a correctness measure. GPU and CPU arms are never compared as if equivalent.

purpose: Observed evidence coverage across every natural-data regime, never pooled
caveat: Regimes differ in case selection and configuration; the spread is not a trend.

purpose: Synthetic vs natural correction shipping rates, explicitly marked non-equivalent
caveat: Disjoint populations with different base rates by construction. 72.2% and 1.8% do NOT measure the same capability and must never be plotted as a single trend.

purpose: Why claims resolve to NO_EVIDENCE, across all 797 claims in project history
dataset: 797 pooled claims from every natural experiment
caveat: A NO_EVIDENCE claim is not shown to be wrong — the corpus is ~140 provisions and most citations simply fall outside it.

purpose: Claim-parser fix (commit 223eb9d) re-parse of the same 30 generated texts
fresh_or_historical: HISTORICAL REPRODUCTION (code change not re-executed; statistic recomputed fresh)
caveat: This is a code-version ablation, not a configuration ablation, and is measured separately from the four production levers.

purpose: Historical vs freshly-reproduced GPU experiment values (STEP 10 / 10B)
caveat: Exact reproduction under greedy decoding evidences pipeline stability across machines. It adds no new statistical evidence about legal correctness.

purpose: Per-component test counts and representative behaviour cases
caveat: Per-component counts overlap where tests span stages; 205 is the only authoritative non-duplicated total — never sum the component rows.

purpose: Usable canonical-evidence pool size for each system, loaded live from source
fresh_or_historical: FRESH (computed live via the unmodified production loader)
caveat: Only VERIFIED_EXACT / VERIFIED_CONTENT audit verdicts are usable; SOURCE_ONLY / INVALID / UNRESOLVED are excluded by design.
